approved_translation: Like the ocean that receives all rivers yet remains unmoved, the wise remain steady amid life's events.
context_summary: Krishna compares the perfect soul to the ocean, which receives water from all rivers and streams yet never overflows its banks. Similarly, the wise person experiences the world's pleasures and pains without being disturbed by them. They remain full and complete within themselves.
interpretation_boundaries: Show water flowing into a vast, calm sea
Emphasize the stability and depth of the ocean
